Get the per-gene marker summaries across all rivals

get_marker_summary.Rd

Returns the summaries a marker is judged on: the AUROC of the reference against its rivals reduced to one row per gene and reference group. Rank on median_auroc for a marker that survives a single closely related rival, or on min_auroc when it has to beat every rival unambiguously.

Usage

get_marker_summary(x)

# S3 method for class 'ScSpecificMarkers'
get_marker_summary(x)

Arguments

x

ScSpecificMarkers object.

Value

A copy of the summary data.table.

Examples

# per gene summaries across every rival group
sc <- demo_single_cells()
res <- find_specific_markers_sc(
  sc,
  column_of_interest = "cell_grp",
  .verbose = FALSE
)
head(get_marker_summary(res))
